methodology.name: Neon Tokyo Weekly JP Score v1
methodology.description: Weekly medium-term Japan equity screen using trend template, relative strength vs TOPIX, breakout freshness, base quality, volume accumulation, tradability and risk controls.
methodology.trade_rule: A+ Fresh Breakout or A Leader, score >= 750, sufficient liquidity, controlled extension.
methodology.watch_rule: B Constructive Setup or C Early Watch without severe liquidity/distribution risk.
methodology.avoid_rule: Extended, distribution week, very low liquidity, low score or stage-2 failure.
